2021_228_oct_2021_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) report for October 2021, carried on the Board of Education agenda for the December 14, 2021 meeting, itemizes every district PCARD charge posted under the journal entry label "OCT PCARD EXP," with columns for transaction description, JE number, budget unit, account code, transaction amount, and credits. Line-item dates run from 9/28/2021 through 10/25/2021, and each of the 33 numbered pages carries the print date 12/9/2021. The listing closes with a subtotal of 256,370.34 against 10,003.18 in credits and a stated Total Expenses of 246,367.16. The single largest line is a SOLARWINDS charge of 6,541.44 dated 10/7/2021 to budget unit 101790284000000, account code 3450.
2021_228_oct_2021_pcard_report.page:
**Document**
Troy School District, PCARD report, October 2021 — a transaction-level listing of district purchasing-card activity submitted to the Board of Education for its December 14, 2021 meeting. Every page repeats the header "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, October 2021" and the column set "Transaction Description / JE Number / Budget Unit / A/C Code / Transaction Amount / Credits." Page footers are numbered 1 through 33 and all show the print date 12/9/2021.

**Coverage and format**
Each row begins with a posting date and a truncated merchant name (for example "10/1/2021-AMZN MKTP US"), followed by the journal entry label "OCT PCARD EXP," a 15-digit budget unit, a four-digit account code, and the amount in either the charge or the credit column. Dates on the lines range from 9/28/2021 to 10/25/2021.
